title: HSS08 12-round AES-192 Five-round internal-modification equivalence

target.description: Full standard AES-192 is the reference computation. Compare it on the SAME(P,K) with deltaAES, whose already-expanded round keys receive20 individually computed byte XOR offsets in a five-consecutive-full-round window. This is not a collision between ordinary AES inputs or master keys.

setting.key_relation: The delta algorithm takes the concrete plaintext P and known key K; offsets are applied AFTER ordinary key expansion, not obtained by a second related master key.
setting.key_population: Any source plaintext/key pair for which the delta construction computes valid offsets.
setting.plaintext_model: One concrete P,K is supplied to the delta algorithm, including intermediate-state computation. Every distinct(P,K) needs a new offset computation.
assumptions: Twenty extra byte XORs afterARK: four positions in each of five rounds containing SB,SR,MC,ARK.
Exclude the final AES round withoutMC from each modification window.
If an offset choice produces dependent linear equation groups, retry initial offsets; source reports no such event in its large-sample experiments.

evidence.interpretation: Complete primary and all equation appendices read. Twenty plaintext/key-dependent byte offsets apply after ordinary expansion; no related-master-key attack. Eight displayed fixed 2×2 systems have determinant04 in AES GF(256), a bounded local check rather than full algorithm reproduction.

limitations: The first four non-all-zero offsets have source cardinality2^32−1; the remaining16 are derived for each supplied(P,K). This is not a master-key class or attack tuning domain.
The original dependent-system retry qualification is retained. Local fixed-coefficient rank checks do not establish every layout/window or reproduce the full δ algorithm.

property.statement: For a fixed plaintext P and AES-192 key K, the source delta algorithm computes20 byte offsets at four positions afterARK in five consecutive FULL rounds includingMC. Applying them leaves the input to the following round unchanged, hence AES_K(P)=deltaAES_(K,delta(P,K))(P). Four layouts {0,2,8,10},{4,6,12,14},{1,3,9,11},{5,7,13,15} and windows starting at1..7 give28 layout/window choices. The first four non-all-zero offsets have2^32-1 initial choices; the other16 follow from the construction. This does not prove that every initial choice has independent linear systems.
property.quantifier: Author construction for each supplied(P,K), with valid computed offsets and retries if the intermediate linear systems are dependent.
property.scope: Equality between standardAES and explicitly internally modified deltaAES on the SAME input/key; not unknown-key recovery, a standard related-key relation, or a standardAES collision.
